hook_line: IMMIGRATION COURT DEADLINES CUT TO 10 DAYS

hook_stat.sub: To file pleadings and evidence in US removal cases

stats.label: Previous window to file applications for relief or protection
Form EOIR-28 filing cutoff before a master calendar hearing
Time for the other side to respond to pleadings and evidence

diaspora_bullets: Have representation in place early — filing Form EOIR-28 moves a case onto the written track
A missed deadline can mean a final order of removability
news_summary: A new EOIR policy memo, effective November 23, cuts filing deadlines in US immigration court removal cases to 10 days for represented respondents.
payoff: Miss the deadline and the application is deemed waived; DHS can seek a final order of removability.
